description:
[Admin] Read the company's portal configuration as editable documents: `branding` (portal name, style, colours, logos, e-mail sender name), `interview-portal` (languages, home texts), `coaching-portal` (vertical, feature toggles, labels, languages, home blocks), `brands` (sub-brands, when switched on) and one `jobmojito.portal-site` document per portal (every page's draft content and the theme CSS, plus `style_settings` and `css_files` when switched on). Narrow with `sections` (branding, interview-portal, coaching-portal, interview-pages, coaching-pages, brands): the page documents are the large ones. With page documents the answer also has `block_types`: every block a page can hold, what it is for, when to use it and its fields; a page holds only these block types. The documents are in the format update_portal_configuration takes, and fields a document leaves out keep their value there.

Every argument in full, with examples: get_tool_reference.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

sections.description: Comma-separated sections to return (default: all): branding, interview-portal, coaching-portal, interview-pages, coaching-pages, brands. A portal the company does not use is left out of the default; name its sections to read them anyway.

name: get_portal_configuration
title: Get portal configuration
